description:
Aggregate the work that delivers this outcome: system actors, gate-run actors, query filters and lease records carry Assignee and dedicated id types.

## Background

This story groups the tasks of epic 2195c98f that share one design surface, so they can be reviewed together once each has landed.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: System actors are named `Assignee` constants, and gate-run actors and query assignee filters are `Assignee` values.
- [hard] REQ-02: Lease records hold an `Assignee` agent, an `IssueId` issue, a `LeaseId` and a `WorktreeId`.
title: Actors and leases carry typed identities
